name: minimax-bot-mobile
description: Native mobile client (web / iOS / Android) for the @minimax-bot team.
author: @nattiini45 (and contributors)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @minimax-bot/protocol && npm run build -w @minimax-bot/relay && npm run sync:protocol -w @minimax-bot/bridge
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @minimax-bot/protocol && npm run sync:protocol -w @minimax-bot/bridge && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @minimax-bot/bridge && vitest run && npm run test -w @minimax-bot/app
scripts.test:policy: node --test scripts/test/build-hardening.test.mjs scripts/test/ci-policy.test.mjs scripts/test/install-policy.test.mjs scripts/test/onboarding.test.mjs scripts/test/dependency-policy.test.mjs
